case: nested collections containing UHUGEINT refuse lossy consumers
contract: A STRUCT containing a UHUGEINT list and a MAP containing a UHUGEINT struct are checked against native typeof() and to_json() oracles, including SQL NULL elements.
The result decoder explicitly refuses both shapes as Undecodable(STRUCT) or Undecodable(MAP), rather than flattening or narrowing nested values.
SQL literal rendering and parameter rebinding both refuse the undecodable values.
